canonical_pipeline: packed integer quote -> multiply instrument price_unit -> quote price; build bars and all indicators in quote-price units; convert to instrument points only for reporting/stress; execute on side-specific raw quote price

XAUUSD.packed_price_unit: 0.01 USD price per stored integer unit

NDX.packed_price_unit: 0.1 index price per stored integer unit

management_units.OPPOSITE_FRACTAL: quote-price distance abs(entry-side-specific price - frozen opposite fractal boundary)
management_units.R: positive initial stop distance in quote-price units after executable entry is known
management_units.TARGET_R: entry plus/minus R multiple in quote-price units
management_units.TRAIL_FAST_EMA: side-specific executable stop constrained by current causal fast EMA quote price

cost_units.spread: already embodied in Ask/Bid execution prices
cost_units.NDX_commission: USD per order per contract; convert to R only through contract_size * quote-price R distance * volume; no account-level USD PnL required
cost_units.XAUUSD_commission: 0.000025 * fill_price * 100 * volume USD per order; convert to R only through contract_size * quote-price R distance * volume

apply ATR storage-scale divisor inherited from unrelated campaign
convert signal thresholds directly to USD
